description: Use when writing backend or API-key integration code for Didit Transaction Monitoring (KYT), crypto wallet screening and the FATF / EU TFR Travel Rule. Use when the user wants to monitor transactions in real time, score transactions against AML/fraud rules, create, back-test or install monitoring rules by API, list or read monitored transactions, screen crypto wallets or transaction hashes against blockchain analytics, render a wallet-screening PDF, comply with the crypto Travel Rule (originator/beneficiary exchange with counterparty VASPs), verify self-hosted wallet ownership, register after-deposit (sunrise) transfers, mint SDK transaction tokens for client-side submission, or step up risky transactions with biometric re-verification using Didit.

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
